prospect.family_status: Lives with family; both parents died
prospect.training_background: Former US Navy sailor. Has held a gym membership for years but trains without any plan and inconsistently.
prospect.medical: No diagnosed condition disclosed. Reports doctors advising her to build muscle because of age-related muscle loss and bone protection. Menstruating.

signals: 'I lost people from, you know, my parents died. Everyone was getting sick left and right. I lost my job, all that stuff.'
'Finally, I could breathe and then make a decision. must have some changes, I guess, to get better, to get my life back.'
Former Navy sailor: 'I knew what needs to get done' — wants a prior version of herself back

goals.text: Build and retain muscle mass because women lose it with age
Protect her bones so she does not break anything, and live longer
Get to a bodyweight between 130 and 150 lb at 5'4"
Regain the discipline she had when she was younger

pains.text: Has gained a lot of weight over the years and lost the discipline she used to have
Bereavement and job loss took over her life and pushed training aside
Goes to the gym but follows no plan or programme
Paid thousands of dollars to Instagram programmes that handed her a video library and disappeared
Does not know whether her form is correct — worries about doing a swing wrong

objections.raw_quote: I see a lot of programs that I see on Instagram. I did sign up for like a few things. They're like, I'll sign up and we'll help you with that. So after I paid thousands of dollars, , they're gone. They're like, okay, here. Here's the website. Watch all these videos and figure it out yourself. I'm like, okay, amazing. Some people are just out there for money.
objections.rep_response: Reflected it back as a need for one-to-one guidance and agreed that videos alone do not produce results, but never addressed the trust concern or offered any proof.

evidence: Rep terminated discovery early because of the prospect's environment: 'it's going to be very hard for me to show my screen and completely hear everything that you're saying, because here and there, you're calling out a lot. So I would say, let's just continue this conversation tomorrow'
Prospect agreed to the same time the next day from a quiet space: 'Yeah, I'll be home.'
No offer, price or programme structure was presented at any point

Counter-evidence on intent: prospect was eating breakfast, on a phone, with family interrupting, and at one point asked 'what is it that you want me to answer... You're not gonna approve me or something?'
outcome.next_step: Rescheduled call the following day at the same time from a quiet space; rep to send a new calendar invite and a WhatsApp message.

notable.note: Call was abandoned roughly 17 minutes in because of background noise and the prospect eating; the substance of this opportunity therefore sits in a second recording that is not in this batch. The prospect is 5'4" and 215 lb — squarely inside the exclusion the stated ICP uses to define itself — and the rep told her 'it sounds like it's a good fit.' Rep also offered to message her from his personal number.

quality.notes: Heavy and sustained label inversion.
